Voice of Turkey FAQ

What frequency is Voice of Turkey on?
In the B-26 season Voice of Turkey is scheduled on 43 shortwave frequencies, including 5945, 5960, 5980, 6000, 6050, 6120 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 6125 kHz (11 pm – 12 am Eastern). For Europe: 6050 kHz (8:30 pm – 9:30 pm UTC+1).

What time is Voice of Turkey on shortwave?
Voice of Turkey is scheduled in 38 UTC time windows this season, from 01:00–03:00 UTC through 23:00–24h UTC. English broadcasts: 23:00–24h UTC; 19:30–20:30 UTC; 04:00–05:00 UTC; 21:30–22:30 UTC. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear Voice of Turkey in the USA?
Yes. Voice of Turkey is beamed at North America this season on 5960, 6125 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 6125 kHz (11 pm – 12 am Eastern).

Does Voice of Turkey broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 5960 kHz at 23:00–24h UTC to E. North America; 6050 kHz at 19:30–20:30 UTC to W. Europe; 6125 kHz at 04:00–05:00 UTC to North America; 7285 kHz at 04:00–05:00 UTC to Middle East; 9610 kHz at 21:30–22:30 UTC to South Asia; plus 2 more.

Is Voice of Turkey on the air right now?
As of Friday, November 6, 2026, 12:56 UTC, Voice of Turkey is scheduled to be broadcasting on 11970 kHz to Europe. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
